items.title: Ulta Beauty CEO says customers as young as 8 are shopping for skincare
items.summary:
“If you can provide it in a safe way, I think that’s the responsibility of a retailer.”

Ulta Beauty CEO Kecia Steelman says shoppers as young as 8 are coming into its stores.

At the F500 Innovation Forum, in conversation with Ellie Austin, she said Ulta has a responsibility to educate kids and parents on what’s safe, and is working with brands on products that are safe for kids to use.

items.title: Ulta Beauty (ULTA) Adds Japanese Double Cleansing Displays To 400 Stores
items.summary: DHC expands its Japanese skincare ritual collection into dedicated Ulta Beauty (NasdaqGS:ULTA) fixtures across 400 stores in the United States. The rollout pairs DHC's existing Deep Cleansing Oil with a new Deep Cleansing Face Wash to create a full double cleansing set. The products are placed within Ulta Beauty's prestige skincare assortment, targeting shoppers interested in established Japanese beauty routines.
